description: This file defines a Fragment class named NoteDetailFragment which displays detailed information of a note, including its title, content, creation and update timestamps. It also provides actions to edit or delete the note.

classes.name: NoteDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment showing detailed information about a specific note, with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and retrieves the note ID from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewModel, observes note data, and binds UI actions for edit and delete.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up binding reference when view is destroyed.
